title: Modern UI Changelog
description: Changelog for Open Screen Recorder (OSR Studio) Modern UI (main branch)

sections.title: Installation Changes
items: Added variant detection to prevent parallel installation of Modern and Classic UI versions
Both Modern and Classic UI now install to the same location (mutually exclusive)
Installer will block installation if the other UI variant is already installed
Users must uninstall one variant before installing the other
Fixed installation directory to properly support 64-bit systems

sections.title: Improvements
items: Simplified installation process - both variants install as the complete app
Improved 64-bit support with proper Program Files directory detection
Added 'Open Screen Recorder' full name to installer and branding

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed overlay preview not respecting Display property for keystrokes and elapsed time overlays

sections.title: Rebranding
items: Complete rebrand from nCaptura to Open Screen Recorder (OSR Studio)
Updated application name, icons, and branding throughout
New modern logo with light/dark theme variants
Updated website with new branding and design
Refreshed GitHub repository with new identity

sections.title: Documentation
items: Updated all documentation to reflect Open Screen Recorder (OSR Studio) branding
Enhanced README with better project description
Added comprehensive credits section
Improved GitHub Pages website

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed various UI inconsistencies after rebranding
Corrected localization strings
